summary: Ranks member completions from recent code. Ignores comments.
limitations: Trained on one repository with a narrower member list than the compiler offers. Extension methods are not ranked. Scores are relative, not confidence.

provenance.corpus: WpfStudio's own C# source, mined with Roslyn. No Microsoft model weights or predictions.

evaluation: 2,012 held-out examples from 50 files of the training repository: top-1 41.95%, top-5 80.72%, MRR@5 0.5646.
